ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to solutioning-related Opportunity fields once the Opportunity reaches Booking Verification, unless the user has the appropriate override permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Opportunity_Fields_Locked__c = TRUE, NOT(Bypass_Validation__c), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification") ) ), OR( ISCHANGED(Desired_Future_State__c), ISCHANGED(Success_Criteria__c), ISCHANGED(Business_Case_Justification__c), ISCHANGED(Solution_Approach_Validated__c), ISCHANGED(Technical_Validation_Completed__c), ISCHANGED(Internal_Approvals_Received__c), ISCHANGED(Deal_Review_Accepted__c), ISCHANGED(Fuel_Surcharge_Waiver__c), ISCHANGED(Free_Storage_Period__c), ISCHANGED(IM_Servicing_Region__c), ISCHANGED(No_of_Forecast_Billing_Month__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fields cannot be edited once the Opportunity reaches a restricted sales stage.
